scope: Six declared previously seen seed11 HybridO/P0/W100 circuits. Uniform original, initial-global and iteration2-global scope for A0/R1/fullU; no per-circuit best selection. Direct controls/independent audits/input seals gate legal comparisons. Missing or running delayed roles stay declared; failed CPD excluded. Process times are development observations, never formal speedup ratios.
